title: TurtIe - Wax Super Hard Shell Finish Liquid 100 ml | Long-Lasting Gloss & Paint Protection | Carnauba Wax Formula | Restores Shine & Repels Water
description: Enhance and protect your vehicle’s paintwork with this Super Hard Shell Finish Liquid Car Wax, formulated to deliver a deep, long-lasting shine along with reliable paint protection. The advanced carnauba-based liquid wax formula cleans, shines, and seals painted surfaces, restoring dull and faded paint to a smooth, glossy, showroom-like finish. This liquid wax creates a durable hard shell protective layer that helps repel water, reduce water spots, and speed up drying time after washing. With built-in UV protection, it helps prevent paint fading, oxidation, and damage caused by prolonged sun exposure, keeping your car’s exterior looking newer for longer. It is safe and effective for use on clear coat paint and lacquered finishes. The easy-to-apply liquid formula spreads evenly and buffs off smoothly without streaks or residue, making it suitable for both beginners and experienced car detailing enthusiasts. Regular application helps maintain gloss, enhance color depth, and protect paint from environmental contaminants such as dust, dirt, and moisture. Ideal for cars, sedans, SUVs, and other painted automotive surfaces, this 100 ml car wax is perfect for routine maintenance, detailing, and long-term paint care. Whether you’re reviving old paint or protecting a new finish, this hard shell liquid wax delivers professional-quality shine and protection at home.

specifications.Recommended Uses For Product: Protecting car paint from UV rays, water spots, dirt, and oxidation; enhancing surface appearance with deep gloss and shine
